questions.stem: A 7-year-old boy is brought to the pediatric clinic by his mother, who is concerned about his frequent episodes of "daydreaming." She reports that during these episodes, which last several seconds and occur multiple times a day, her son appears completely disengaged and unresponsive to verbal cues. Outside of these episodes, the boy is described as attentive and capable of completing tasks without difficulty. His academic performance is satisfactory, and he is not known to be disruptive in the classroom. The mother is worried these episodes are affecting his learning and social interactions. Which of the following is the best next step in management?

options.label: A
options.text: Obtain further information from his parents and teachers with the Conners rating scale.

options.label: B
options.text: Begin a program of behavioral modification.

options.label: C
options.text: Reassure the child’s mother that this behavior is age appropriate.

options.label: D
options.text: Send the child for an electroencephalogram.
